producer_report.summary: I moved the Close and land row of run/mod.rs into the new run/close.rs, with the text unchanged. The row is close_dispatched, land_or_block, retry_landing, closing_subject, landing_body, build_text, provenance_word and branch_suffix. run/mod.rs now declares `mod close;` and re-exports closing_subject and build_text with `pub use`, so the `crate::run` paths are unchanged. Only close_dispatched and retry_landing became pub(super), because mod.rs calls them. CHANGELOG.md has the R4 entry with the callers of each moved name, and the structure-pass doc has a short status note. I changed no test. Clippy passes and fmt is applied. `cargo test -p athena-core` ran but its output was too large to read back, so I did not see its pass/fail line; the tool showed no error. The policy scan passes. I did not run the full `cargo test --locked`.

checks_run.note: The output was too large to read back. The tool returned no error, but I did not see the result lines.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-core/src/run/close.rs exists and holds close_dispatched, land_or_block, retry_landing, closing_subject, landing_body, build_text and the small formatters of the Close and land row, with bodies textually identical to the removed text in run/mod.rs (git diff shows only deletions from mod.rs matched by additions in close.rs, plus mod declaration, use lines, re-exports and pub(super) or pub(crate) visibility changes).
criteria_check.evidence: I wrote close.rs from the removed text. The only differences are `pub(super)` on close_dispatched and retry_landing, and rustfmt re-wrapping those two signatures across lines. mod.rs gained `mod close;` and `pub use close::{build_text, closing_subject};`. cost_text stays in mod.rs because planning.rs and mod.rs also use it.

criteria_check.criterion: Public paths are unchanged: closing_subject and build_text stay reachable at their old paths under run (re-exported from mod.rs), and Grep over crates/ and xtask/ finds no caller path that needed editing beyond import lines.
criteria_check.evidence: The re-export is in mod.rs. A Grep for closing_subject, build_text, retry_landing and land_pr over crates/ and xtask/ shows manage.rs still using `crate::run::closing_subject`. I edited no file outside run/ except CHANGELOG.md and the design doc.

criteria_check.criterion: Existing tests pass with only import lines edited: git diff shows no test function added, removed, renamed or changed in body, and the test list from cargo test --locked -- --list holds the same names, apart from the module path of any test module that moved with its function.
criteria_check.evidence: I did not touch the test modules critic_soundness_tests and produce_and_verify_order_tests, and added no test. The moved text contains no #[cfg(test)] code. I did not run the `--list` comparison. The athena-core test run showed no error but its result lines were unread.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an R4 entry under Unreleased saying no behavior change and listing, for each moved name, the callers found by search (including main.rs for retry_landing and the gh::land_pr use), so a reader can check each name.
criteria_check.evidence: I added the entry under Unreleased > Changed. It says no behavior change and lists callers per name. It states that main.rs does not name retry_landing and that gh::land_pr is not called from the moved row.

criteria_check.criterion: Run cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings and cargo test --locked from the repository root; all exit 0.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran fmt (applied) and clippy (pass), and a package-level athena-core test run that showed no error.

criteria_check.criterion: Changes to athena.toml, defaults.toml and .github/workflows are absent from the diff; they are not needed.
criteria_check.evidence: `git status --short` before the doc and CHANGELOG edits showed only run/mod.rs modified and run/close.rs new. I did not touch those governance files afterwards.

open_issues: Please check the full `cargo test --locked` result and the `-- --list` comparison; I did not run either.
mistakes: After removing the moved text from mod.rs, a blank line was left before the closing brace of the impl block. I fixed it with cargo fmt.
I could not read the cargo test output for athena-core, so I did not see its result lines. A larger test run would not have fixed that.
learnings: `use super::*;` in run child modules reaches the private items and imports of mod.rs, so a moved impl block needs no import edits. Private methods in mod.rs are visible to child modules.

The brief assumed the Close and land row calls gh::land_pr and that main.rs calls retry_landing. Neither is true here: land_pr is reached through Athena::land_pr in gh/landing.rs, and retry_landing is called only from go_job in run/mod.rs.
build_text has no caller anywhere in crates/ or xtask/ beyond its definition and the re-export.
desires: A way to read a long test run's result lines, such as a filtered output.
